collection.title: VW Golf Hatchback 2006 to 2009 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a VW Golf Hatchback 2006 to 2009 model which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 19" for the passengers side. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Golf Hatchback which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
